definitions.short: a joiner , i.e. brace or cramp
definitions.full: H4226. mechabberah [ מְחַבְּרָה ] noun feminine binder, clamp, joint , only plural absolute מְחבְּרוֺת , of iron, clamps or the like, 1Chr 22:3 ; of wood, binder , or coupling , 2Chr 34:11 .
